resolution: Both visible compiled-game faults fixed (commits 828666228 + 210d61013). (1) Bushes-as-flat-shards / missing prop backs: streamed draws were truncated to 36 vertices regardless of shape — spheres lost everything past the top polar ring; the bake data was proven healthy by probing the real gamefile, so the fix is loader-side: per-family vertex counts from the proto's own slice. (2) The 180°-rotated decals from your earlier screenshot: the world box's face samples textures rotated relative to the raster origin (shader materials are rotation-agnostic so it was never visible before); the rasterizer now rotates its output once at the end — text reads upright in the compiled game. Verify: rjit game play, walk to the bushes and the sign wall. Note: NET CAFE walls are a separate pre-existing gap — they're hand-coded react facades, not decals, and were never in the MATERIALS lump; they retire with the V24 building work.
